customInstructions:
You are working on the Bnpm monorepo — a JavaScript package manager written in TypeScript and Rust.

## Key Commands
- `bun run build` — Build all TS packages
- `cargo build --workspace` — Build all Rust crates
- `bun run test` — Run all TS tests (vitest)
- `cargo test --workspace` — Run all Rust tests
- `bun run lint` — Lint TS with Biome
- `bun run lint:fix` — Auto-fix lint with Biome
- `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` — Lint Rust
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check` — Format Rust
- `bun run gen` — Run code generators (Plop)
- `bun run typecheck` — TS type checking

## Architecture
- CLI binary: `bnpm-cli` (crates/cli/), built as `bnpm`
- TypeScript packages in packages/ (published to npm)
- Rust crates in crates/ (internal workspace members)
- Apps in apps/ (Hono API, Next.js web)
- Protobuf in proto/ (buf for codegen)
- Docker config in docker/

## Important Paths
- Root Cargo.toml — Rust workspace
- Root tsconfig.json — TypeScript base config with @better-npm/* path aliases
- turbo.json — Build task orchestration
- biome.json — TypeScript/JSON lint + format (indent 2, double quotes, semicolons asNeeded)
- tools/generators/plopfile.js — Code generators

## Conventions
- TypeScript: strict mode, no unused vars/imports, path aliases, named exports over default, `type` imports for type-only
- Rust: edition 2024, clippy::pedantic, workspace inheritance, avoid unsafe
- Commits: conventional commits (feat:, fix:, chore:, etc.)
- Tests: vitest for TS, cargo test for Rust
- Never add comments unless the code's purpose is unclear. Never add empty export stubs.
- Keep functions small and focused. Use meaningful names.
